## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit message is a [conventional commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
- [ ] `mise run check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for any change in behaviour
- [ ] The README and `docs/` are updated for any change a user would notice
- [ ] The chart's `version` is bumped if the chart changed, and the README is updated if a value or default has changed
